name: Kimpton Hotel Palomar Philadelphia
positioning: Design-led hotel in a converted 1920s building in Center City, steps from Rittenhouse Square
best_for: Travelers who want a Center City base near Rittenhouse Square
Guests travelling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Center City, steps from Rittenhouse Square and Philadelphia City Hall.
The hotel is housed in a converted 1920s building.
The hotel has a LEED Gold sustainability certification.
Square 1682 serves creative cocktails with hearty cuisine and produce from a rooftop garden.
The hotel provides pet beds and food and water bowls free of charge.
Spa Rooms come with a deep soaking Fuji tub and a standalone shower.
In the evening, staff host guests over complimentary wine or hot toddies, depending on the season.
EV charging spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

highlights.text: Installations of pinwheels made from blueprints decorate the hotel, alongside local artists' pieces.
The lobby has design touches such as pop art busts of Benjamin Franklin and ceramic roller skates.
Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.

considerations.text: Parking is by valet, for a fee.
The hotel has no local area shuttle.
WhataHotel notes that the Center City setting brings street noise that may not suit travelers seeking a quieter retreat.
